quote.text: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: William H. Whyte, Fortune, 1950 — the sentence for a week of announcements nobody made

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · fountain pens, the pen itself
stories.headline: Eleven of a hundred and sixty-two wrote properly out of the box
stories.dek: The ink and the paper were settled at No. 106. The instrument is a harder argument, because the part that touches the page is the same welded pellet on a forty-dollar pen and a four-thousand-dollar one — and the one category where Singapore is thirty per cent cheaper than America.

stories.headline: The whole craft rests on a gap of nine and a half millimetres
stories.dek: Below six, bees glue it shut with propolis. Above nine and a half, they build comb across it. Inside the band they leave it alone — and that single tolerance, patented in 1852, is the reason a frame lifts out of a hive at all.

stories.headline: Book by Tuesday, or pay the levy on every ticket you buy afterwards
stories.dek: The airline’s winter schedule is its biggest since 2020 — and South Asia and Bali are where it took the capacity from. Meanwhile a ticketing deadline three days away decides what your next long-haul fare costs.

stories.headline: Seven days, priced at twelve billion dollars and a driveway answer
stories.dek: Tehran put a dated, sequenced offer on the table on Thursday: five days of American steps, the strait open on the sixth, talks on the seventh. Trump answered it standing outside the White House, in four words.

stories.headline: Singapore became a super-aged society on Thursday. The threshold is in footnote nine
stories.dek: Twenty-one point four per cent of citizens are now sixty-five or older, and the United Nations line is twenty-one. Nobody said so out loud: the milestone arrived inside a PDF, under a chart, on a weekday afternoon.

stories.headline: A rule that took effect two days before anyone could read it
stories.dek: Commerce made stockpiling polysilicon an import offence, backdated the start, and set the weekly allowance for a new importer at twelve kilogrammes. The material it invokes national security to protect is 2.4 per cent of the trade it regulates.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · on sale Wednesday
stories.headline: Six hundred and sixty-nine dollars, and Singapore is a launch market for once
stories.dek: The third-generation Ray-Ban Meta went on sale here the day it was announced, with a published Singapore price. Two of its three headline features are not in the box yet, and the number a buyer will test first has never been independently measured.

stories.headline: A hundred and sixty thousand euros, eighteen pieces, and no website to buy it from
stories.dek: Minerva has stepped out from under Montblanc to stand on its own name after a hundred and sixty-eight years. Its first move as an independent house is a suspended tourbillon in yellow gold — and a domain that does not resolve.

stories.headline: The longest number-one run in the history of the Hot 100 is sitting at number two in Britain
stories.dek: Ella Langley’s twenty-third week at the top of one chart is the same week she spends beaten on another. Both numbers are correct; naming the chart is the whole job.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · the evidence at twelve
stories.headline: The world’s first under-sixteen social media ban is nine months old. For twelve-year-olds it changed almost nothing
stories.dek: Australia switched it on last December. The first peer-reviewed evaluation, split by age band, finds the twelve-to-thirteens barely moved — and the over-sixteens used more.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · the week to Friday
stories.headline: Three central banks raised rates inside nine days, and the dollar declined to notice
stories.dek: The Fed hiked for the first time since 2023, the BoJ took Japan to its highest rate since 1995, and the ten-year went to 5.06 per cent. The currency that should have been the beneficiary fell.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · the number that moved
stories.headline: Stop asking what your VO2 max is. Ask which way it is going
stories.dek: Eleven and a half thousand people, two fitness tests four years apart, fourteen years of follow-up. The finding is not the level — it is the annual slope, and there is no threshold at which improving stops paying.

stories.headline: One ballot has already closed, one show sold out in four nights, and one Christmas has not been announced at all
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a promoter, a venue or an official ticketing page this weekend. Three things previous issues listed are not happening in the form they were listed.

stories.headline: Jhut
stories.dek: Bangladesh has run one of the largest circular economies on earth for forty years without anyone calling it that. Now Brussels has written rules that turn its cutting-floor scrap into a regulated feedstock — and the effect is an enclosure act.
